title: Coupled roll-spiral mode prohibited in CO/GA-type maneuvering phases: Level 1, Category A (Flight Phases CO, GA)

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

source.extract_quote: "such as CO and GA", a coupled roll-spiral mode in response to pilot roll commands is not allowed

encoding: boolean prohibition: coupled_roll_spiral_present <= 0 (the mode shall not exist)

conditions.search: grid, optional one-step local refinement around the critical point

status_policy.rule: No status other than OK can improve a verdict (FC-702); a DIVERGENT point fails every Level; no usable point gives NOT_ASSESSABLE (FC-701)

notes: Boolean: airplane shall not exhibit a coupled roll-spiral mode in response to pilot roll commands. Levels not distinguished in text.
